tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Browse the template catalog without a keyword: by category (topics, industries, shapes, dashboards, maps, tombstones), newest first, or most popular. With no category, returns templates across all categories. Each category holds roughly 10 to 50 templates, so a category listing is usually complete.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_templates, search_slides, get_template, get_slide, list_free_templates · Private data: list_free_templates · Public sink: list_free_templates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_templates, search_slides, get_template, get_slide, list_free_templates · Private data: list_free_templates · Public sink: list_free_templates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
